headline: More mortgages, new clients: the challenge for banking in Mexico
summary: Difficulty verifying income through traditional channels limits bank access for independent workers and entrepreneurs, even though many may have repayment capacity for mortgages.
why: Mortgage lending is a core business for banks and a key driver of housing credit growth. Expanding lending to non-salaried borrowers affects bank loan growth and credit risk.
original_headline: Más hipotecas, nuevos clientes: el desafío de la banca en México
